title: The Old Soldier
text: A veteran sits by the road in rusted mail, back straight, spear upright, waiting for orders from a war that ended long ago. He does not know it ended. He offers, gruffly, to teach a trick or two to anyone green enough to need it.

outcomes.text: He is a hard teacher, and a good one.

options.label: The leader relieves him of duty.

outcomes.text: He salutes, and goes home at last, wherever that is.

options.label: Ask him to march with you.

outcomes.text: He marches with you as far as the next fight, and fights like ten.
